sloka: अथ अब्रवीद् बाष्प कलाम्स् तिष्ठतः च उपजीविनः ।सम्प्रदाय बहु द्रव्यम् एकैकस्य उपजीविनः ॥२-३२-२४॥
transliteration: atha abravīd bāṣpa kalāms tiṣṭhataḥ ca upajīvinaḥ ।sampradāya bahu dravyam ekaikasya upajīvinaḥ ॥2-32-24॥

translations.english: Rama then bestowed abundant wealth on each of the dependents as they stood with their throats choked with tears, saying:
